description: Estimate per-agent learning rate (alpha) and inverse temperature (beta) for a two-action Q-learning model by maximum likelihood. For each agent, we compute a coarse grid search over alpha and beta to find good starting points, then refine using L-BFGS-B under bounds alpha in [0.01, 0.99] and beta in [0.1, 10]. The likelihood is computed with stable log-sigmoid math, updating only the chosen action’s Q with observed rewards. Missing trials (NaN or invalid choices/rewards) are skipped for both likelihood and learning updates. Returns an (N,2) array with [alpha, beta] for each agent.
